info.name: Typesense Analytics Analytics Events Search API

params.name: collectionName
params.description: Name of the collection.

params.name: q
params.description: The search query string. Use * for wildcard queries.

params.name: query_by
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to search against.

params.name: query_by_weights
params.description: Comma-separated weights for each query_by field.

params.name: text_match_type
params.description: How text matching is calculated. Options are max_score or max_weight.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Whether prefix search is enabled for query_by fields.

params.name: infix
params.description: Enable infix search for specified fields.

params.name: filter_by
params.description: Filter conditions for narrowing search results.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields and sort directions.

params.name: facet_by
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to facet on.

params.name: max_facet_values
params.description: Maximum number of facet values to return.

params.name: facet_query
params.description: Facet query for filtering facet values.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page.

params.name: group_by
params.description: Field to group results by.

params.name: group_limit
params.description: Maximum number of hits per group.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in results.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from results.

params.name: highlight_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to highlight.

params.name: highlight_full_fields
params.description: Fields for which full highlights are returned.

params.name: num_typos
params.description: Number of typographical errors to tolerate per token.

params.name: typo_tokens_threshold
params.description: Minimum token count to enable typo tolerance.

params.name: drop_tokens_threshold
params.description: Token threshold below which tokens are dropped from query.

params.name: pinned_hits
params.description: Comma-separated list of document IDs to pin at specific positions.

params.name: hidden_hits
params.description: Comma-separated list of document IDs to hide from results.

params.name: enable_overrides
params.description: Whether to apply curations and overrides.

params.name: preset
params.description: Name of a preset to use for search parameters.

params.name: vector_query
params.description: Vector query for nearest-neighbor search.

params.name: conversation
params.description: Whether to enable conversational search (RAG).

params.name: conversation_model_id
params.description: ID of the conversation model to use.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: ID of an existing conversation to continue.

items.docs: Searches for documents in a collection using full-text search with typo tolerance, faceting, filtering, sorting, grouping, geo search, and vector search capabilities.
